title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
kidExplanation: Find the k-th biggest number without fully sorting if you can help it (heap / quickselect).
plainProblem: Kth Largest Element in an Array: Find the k-th biggest number without fully sorting if you can help it (heap / quickselect). Worked example — input: nums = [3,2,1,5,6,4], k = 2; expected output: 5. Why: 2nd largest. Interview pattern to name out loud: Heap / priority queue.

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the nested work. If each choice restarts a full scan, time blows up. Name the cost before optimizing — interviewers want that honesty. Target after the insight: See code.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To find the kth largest element in an array, we can use a min-heap (priority queue) with a maximum size of k. As we iterate through the array, we push elements into the min-heap. If the size of the heap exceeds k, we remove the smallest element. The top element of the min-heap will be the kth largest element.
